subject: Horizon Health: customer story recording — on-site plan & release checklist
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@horizonhealth.com>, Tom Garcia <t.garcia@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon Health: customer story recording — on-site plan & release checklist

Hi Alyssa / Tom,

Thanks again for agreeing to do this short customer story with us — we really appreciate the time. To keep things light and efficient, I put together a short on-site plan and the legal/release materials we need signed. High-level ask: confirm availability for Friday, July 11 and sign the release ahead of time so our crew can shoot uninterrupted.

Quick bullets:
- Run of show: 90-minute on-site shoot, 2 talent segments + B-roll at two locations (main lobby + telehealth room)
- Crew: 3-person crew (DP, sound, producer) – will arrive 45 minutes early for set up
- Talent: Alyssa (primary), Tom (optional 10–15s shot)
- Release: short form (attached) that covers use across web, social, and case study materials; we can redline for any legal constraints
- Logistics: parking pass for our team and a single-point contact at your site (name / phone)

Attachments I can send now: testimonial release (PDF) and an editable run-of-show. If you prefer, we can route the release through DocuSign.

If Friday doesn't work, share two alternative dates next week and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0193
[Attachment: Redwood_Testimonial_Release_20260710.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[Attachment: RunOfShow_Horizon_20260711.docx (DOCX, 35KB)]
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@horizonhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Garcia <t.garcia@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Horizon Health: customer story recording — on-site plan & release checklist

Thanks, Olga — this sounds good. Friday, July 11 should work for Alyssa and I, mornings are better. A couple of notes from Legal:
- Can you confirm the exact wording in the release around perpetual usage and whether we can request takedowns?
- We need to see the full questions you'll ask (especially anything about roadmap / pricing) so we can prep.

Parking: I'll reserve a visitor space. Point of contact on the day will be me (cell: +1 617-555-0221).

Please send the full question list and the release in DocuSign and I'll get Legal to sign before Friday.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Director, Patient Experience | Horizon Health
alyssa.chen@horizonhealth.com | +1 617-555-0221

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Horizon Health: customer story recording — on-site plan & release checklist

Hi Alyssa — great, morning on Friday it is. Attached is an updated package:
- Redwood_Testimonial_Release_20260710.pdf (we highlighted the perpetual usage clause and added a takedown process: 30-day notice)
- RunOfShow_Horizon_20260711.docx (editable — run order, question prompts, timing)
- Shotlist_Broll_Horizon.pdf (recommended B‑roll shots and sequence)

Question list excerpt (for Legal):
1) Brief background: tell us about your role and how you use Redwood Inference in production
2) Business impact: concrete metrics (latency, cost reduction, reliability) you can share
3) Use case vignette: a short day-in-the-life example where Redwood made a difference
4) Closing: any advice to teams evaluating inference platforms

We intentionally kept it non-product-technical on roadmap/pricing; we won't ask pricing or future roadmap questions on camera. If Legal wants to narrow the perpetual clause further, we can change perpetual to a 5-year license — happy to accommodate.

I sent the release to DocuSign this morning: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/view?docId=ABCD-1234-HORIZON

Logistics for Friday (tentative):
- Crew call: 08:00 AM arrival, set by 08:45, shoot 09:30–11:00
- Spaces: Main lobby interview (Alyssa, seated), Telehealth room walk-and-talk B‑roll, optional 15s Tom cameo by 10:15
- Wardrobe note: please avoid loud logos; patterns can flicker on camera

Let us know if you want a remote pre-call with our producer (15 minutes) tomorrow to walk through the run-of-show.

Thanks,
Olga

Quick operational note — DP and sound confirmed. I will run the tech check over Zoom on Friday at 07:45 (15-minute call) to confirm camera angles and lavs. Marissa, can you confirm we have a second backup battery pack and that a cardioid lav mic will be in the kit?

Alyssa — Ben here, we'll be respectful of patient-facing areas and keep crew to non-clinical zones unless you give explicit escort. We'll bring floor protectors and small LED fill.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0110
